facts.fact: Deliberation 005/2025 of the data protection authority (APD), adopted 30 July 2025, requires public- and private-sector controllers using cloud services abroad to obtain prior APD authorisation, with a separate foreign-transfer authorisation request where the host country is not on the country list published in deliberation 004/2025. The text is the amended version published 2026-04-30.

The amended deliberation 005/2025 refers to a list of countries published in the APD's deliberation 004/2025, with a hosting choice limited to countries offering adequate protection as that deliberation determines; dated by the 30 July 2025 adoption.
